content.comment_body: I need assistance and would appreciate guidance! I have a sensor from [company_name], and I am trying to decide which controller would be suitable to meet operational requirements for the laser sensor "[company_name], type: [product_name]" [url]. The application should enable stopping the machine at a certain distance for safety reasons. Thank you.

Hello, The correct approach is to follow the machine safety regulations specific to your country. This sensor is not a safety-rated device, and both [product_name] and [product_name] are not certified safety controllers. In cases involving human safety, only safety-certified sensors and an evaluation device (such as a safety PLC) should be used. Always consult local guidelines for selecting appropriate equipment. Regards,

[user_name], the concept is a photocell that measures distance, and when something is detected at 1 meter from the fence, the machine is stopped. The photocell will be attached to a moving part of the machine.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking advice about whether to use [product_name] or [product_name] for integrating with a third-party laser distance sensor in a machine safety context. It has been highlighted that neither product is safety-certified, and regulatory compliance is necessary for human safety situations. The main challenge is a lack of information regarding the use of these controllers in safety-critical applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that a specific controller from [company_name] will be appropriate for handling a safety-related stop using a third-party sensor and expect seamless compatibility and support for their application.
